answer:
Promptfoo 0.123.0 uses the **Responses API** by default for GPT-5.6 and newer models.

The docs say: "For GPT-5.6 and newer models, use `openai:<model>`, such as `openai:gpt-6-luna`. These IDs default to Responses." [promptfoo/site/docs/providers/openai.md]

The 0.123.0 release notes list this as a breaking change: "**providers:** default GPT-5.6+ to Responses ([#10803](https://github.com/promptfoo/promptfoo/issues/10803))" [promptfoo/0.123.0.md]

To use Chat Completions instead, select it explicitly: "Use `openai:chat:<model>` or `openai:responses:<model>` to select the endpoint explicitly, including for a compatible gateway." [promptfoo/site/docs/providers/openai.md]
